note: Tocbot wraps the Tocbot JS library. Configure route tocbot.settings at /admin/config/content/tocbot (perm 'administer site configuration') stores ~30 keys in the tocbot.settings config object (defaults: min_activate '3', content_selector '#content', heading_selector 'h2, h3, h4, h5, h6', toc_selector '.js-toc-block', create_auto_ids 1). The 'Tocbot TOC' block (plugin tocbot_block) renders <div class=js-toc-block> and attaches drupalSettings.tocbot + the library (CDN tocbot/external.tocbot by default, tocbot/internal.tocbot when /libraries/tocbot/dist files exist). No permissions of its own, no Drush, no config schema. Medium cases read back known config values; hard cases set config / place the block and verify live state.

evals.prompt: Where is the Tocbot admin settings page in Drupal, and which setting stops the table of contents from appearing on pages that have only a couple of headings?
evals.expected_output: The settings form is at /admin/config/content/tocbot (route tocbot.settings). The min_activate / minActivate setting (default 3) is the minimum number of matching headings required before Tocbot activates, so raising it prevents a TOC on short pages.

evals.prompt: After enabling the Tocbot module, how do I actually get the table of contents to show up on my pages? What block do I place?
evals.expected_output: Place the 'Tocbot TOC' block (plugin id tocbot_block) into a region via Structure > Block layout. It outputs a <div class="js-toc-block"> and attaches the Tocbot library; on any page whose content_selector container has at least min_activate headings, the TOC is built into that div.

evals.prompt: Does the Tocbot Drupal module load the Tocbot JavaScript library from a CDN or locally, and how do I make it use a local copy?
evals.expected_output: By default it loads from a CDN (tocbot/external.tocbot, cdnjs). If you place the library files at /libraries/tocbot/dist/tocbot.min.js and tocbot.css, TocbotHelper::getLibrary() detects them and switches to the local library (tocbot/internal.tocbot).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, how many headings must a page have before the Tocbot table of contents activates? Inspect the live tocbot configuration and give the number.
evals.expected_output: 7. The live tocbot.settings config has min_activate set to 7, so the TOC only activates when the page has 7 or more matching headings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which CSS selector does Tocbot scan for headings when building the table of contents? Inspect the live tocbot configuration and give the exact selector value.
evals.expected_output: main.toc-content-xyz. The live tocbot.settings config has content_selector set to 'main.toc-content-xyz' (the container Tocbot scans for headings).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Tocbot so the table of contents is built only from h2 and h3 headings and only activates once a page has at least 6 headings. Apply the change to the live tocbot settings.
evals.expected_output: Set tocbot.settings min_activate to 6 and heading_selector to 'h2, h3' (e.g. via the form at /admin/config/content/tocbot or `drush config:set tocbot.settings min_activate 6` and `drush config:set tocbot.settings heading_selector 'h2, h3'`).

evals.prompt: I've enabled the Tocbot module but no table of contents shows up anywhere on my site. Please put the automatic table-of-contents block onto my site so it can display.
evals.expected_output: Place the 'Tocbot TOC' block (plugin tocbot_block) into a region of the active theme -- via Structure > Block layout, or by creating a block.block.* config entity with plugin: tocbot_block and status: true. Any enabled placement of tocbot_block satisfies this.
